entries.exampleDari: این شرکت فرصت‌های شغلی ایجاد کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: īn shirkat fursathā-yi shughlī ījād kard.

entries.exampleDari: رئیس این خبر را تأیید کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ra'īs īn khabar rā ta'yīd kard.

entries.exampleDari: او اشتباه خود را انکار کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ū ishtibāh-i khud rā inkār kard.

entries.exampleDari: متهم به جرم خود اعتراف کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: muttaham ba jurm-i khud i'tirāf kard.
entries.exampleEn: The accused confessed to his crime.
I was embarrassed by my mistake.
My mother was worried about me.

entries.exampleDari: لطفاً آرام شوید و گوش دهید.
entries.exampleTranslit: lutfan ārām shawēd wa gōsh dihēd.

entries.exampleEn: He became disappointed with the result.
I am hopeful for a bright future.
I was surprised to see him.

entries.exampleDari: او چیزی در گوشم زمزمه کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ū chīzē dar gōsh-am zamzama kard.
entries.exampleEn: He whispered something in my ear.
Please do not touch the painting.

entries.exampleDari: دوای خود را به سختی بلعید.
entries.exampleTranslit: dawā-yi khud rā ba sakhtī bal'īd.
entries.exampleEn: He swallowed his medicine with difficulty.

entries.exampleDari: وقتی مریض می‌شوم، زیاد عطسه می‌کنم.
entries.exampleTranslit: waqtī marēz mēshawam, ziyād atsa mēkunam.
entries.exampleEn: When I get sick, I sneeze a lot.
I gained energy by eating fruit.
She took care of the patient.

entries.exampleDari: ما باید به راه خود ادامه دهیم.
entries.exampleTranslit: mā bāyad ba rāh-i khud idāma dihēm.

entries.exampleDari: دو موتر با هم تصادف کردند.
entries.exampleTranslit: dū mōtar bā ham tasāduf kardand.
entries.exampleEn: Two cars collided with each other.
The flight is delayed by one hour.
I cannot focus on my work.

entries.exampleDari: سگرت کشیدن برای صحت مضر است.
entries.exampleTranslit: sigrit kashīdan barāyi sihat muzir ast.

entries.exampleDari: این موضوع برای من بی‌اهمیت است.
entries.exampleTranslit: īn mawzō' barāyi man bē-ahammiyat ast.
entries.exampleEn: This matter is unimportant to me.

entries.exampleDari: طراحی این ساختمان منحصر به فرد است.
entries.exampleTranslit: tarrāhī-yi īn sākhtamān munhasir ba fard ast.
entries.exampleEn: The design of this building is unique.
My father is a generous man.

entries.exampleDari: او آنقدر خسیس است که چیزی نمی‌خرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ū ānqadar khasīs ast ki chīzē namēkharad.
entries.exampleEn: He is so stingy that he doesn't buy anything.

entries.exampleDari: دانش‌آموز زیرک سوالات را حل کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: dānish-āmōz-i zērak suwālāt rā hal kard.
entries.exampleEn: The clever student solved the questions.
Do not be hasty in decision-making.
I was anxious before the exam.

entries.exampleDari: او نسبت به مشکلات بی‌تفاوت است.
entries.exampleTranslit: ū nisbat ba mushkilāt bē-tafāwut ast.
entries.exampleEn: He is indifferent to the problems.

entries.exampleDari: رفتار او مشکوک به نظر می‌رسید.
entries.exampleTranslit: raftār-i ū mashkūk ba nazar mērasīd.

entries.exampleDari: نباید به آدم دروغگو اعتماد کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: nabāyad ba ādam-i durōghgō i'timād kard.
entries.exampleEn: One should not trust a deceitful person.
A dog is a loyal animal.
The economy is dependent on oil.
The sick child is in the hospital.
The high mountains of Afghanistan are beautiful.

entries.exampleDari: دلیل مشخصی برای این کار وجود دارد.
entries.exampleTranslit: dalīl-i mushakkhasī barāyi īn kār wujūd dārad.
entries.exampleEn: There is a specific reason for this.
Do not be lazy in doing your homework.

entries.exampleDari: از شنیدن این خبر متعجب شدم.
entries.exampleTranslit: az shunīdan-i īn khabar muta'ajjib shudam.
entries.exampleEn: I was astonished to hear this news.

entries.exampleDari: کودک نسبت به همه چیز کنجکاو است.
entries.exampleTranslit: kōdak nisbat ba hama chīz kunjkāw ast.
entries.exampleEn: The child is curious about everything.

entries.exampleDari: آدم مغروری است و دوستان کمی دارد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ādam-i maghrūrī ast wa dōstān-i kamī dārad.
entries.exampleEn: He is an arrogant person and has few friends.

entries.exampleDari: با وجود موفقیت، او بسیار متواضع است.
entries.exampleTranslit: bā wujūd-i muwaffaqiyat, ū bisyār mutawāzi' ast.
entries.exampleEn: Despite his success, he is very humble.
I am ashamed of my behavior.
I was surprised upon seeing the gift.

entries.exampleDari: داستان بر اساس رویدادهای واقعی است.
entries.exampleTranslit: dāstān bar asās-i rōydādhā-yi wāqi'ī ast.
entries.exampleEn: The story is based on real events.

entries.exampleDari: رئیس اهمیت پروژه را خاطرنشان کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ra'īs ahammiyat-i purōzha rā khātir-nishān kard.
entries.exampleEn: The boss pointed out the importance of the project.

entries.exampleDari: او همیشه به آینده امید دارد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō hamēsha ba āyanda umēd dārad.
entries.exampleEn: He always has hope for the future.

entries.exampleDari: موفقیت تو باعث افتخار من است.
entries.exampleTranslit: muwaffaqiyat-i tu bā'is-i iftikhār-i man ast.

entries.exampleDari: او تجربه زیادی در کار دارد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō tajruba-i ziyādī dar kār dārad.
entries.exampleEn: He has a lot of experience in work.

entries.exampleDari: هدف او کمک به مردم است.
entries.exampleTranslit: hadaf-i ō kumak ba mardum ast.
entries.exampleEn: His goal is to help people.
We are hopeful for the future.
Do not think about the past.
The truth will come to light one day.
Telling a lie is a bad thing.
He is our source of pride.
Security is established in the city.

entries.exampleDari: او توانایی انجام این کار را دارد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō tawānā'ī-yi anjām-i īn kār rā dārad.
entries.exampleEn: He has the ability to do this work.
Time has a lot of value.
The quality of this dress is good.

entries.exampleDari: کمیت مهم نیست، کیفیت مهم است.
entries.exampleTranslit: kamiyat muhim nēst, kayfiyat muhim ast.
entries.exampleEn: Quantity is not important, quality is important.
The weather situation is better today.
What is the reason for this action?
The result of the exam will be announced tomorrow.

entries.exampleDari: این حرف روی او تأثیر گذاشت.
entries.exampleTranslit: īn harf rōy-i ō ta'sīr guzāsht.
entries.exampleEn: This statement had an effect on him.
I have a feeling of tiredness.

entries.exampleDari: او خشم خود را کنترل کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō khashm-i khud rā kuntrōl kard.

entries.exampleEn: The wedding was held with happiness.
He has a great sorrow in his heart.
I had anxiety before the exam.
Do not make haste in work.

entries.exampleDari: من به کمک تو نیاز دارم.
entries.exampleTranslit: man ba kumak-i tu niyāz dāram.
entries.exampleEn: I have a need for your help.
He has a talent for painting.
Too much pride is not good.
Sometimes we go to the cinema.
Balkh was a center of ancient civilization.
The weather is relatively cold today.

entries.exampleDari: در حال حاضر مشغول کار هستم.
entries.exampleTranslit: dar hāl-i hāzir mashghūl-i kār hastam.

entries.exampleEn: We will talk about it later.

entries.exampleDari: اتفاقاً او را در بازار دیدم.
entries.exampleTranslit: ittifāqan ō rā dar bāzār dīdam.
entries.exampleEn: I saw him in the market by chance.

entries.exampleDari: او این کار را عمداً نکرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō īn kār rā amdan nakard.

entries.exampleDari: عموماً مردم این را دوست دارند.
entries.exampleTranslit: umūman mardum īn rā dōst dārand.

entries.exampleDari: من خصوصاً چای سبز را دوست دارم.
entries.exampleTranslit: man khusūsan chāy-i sabz rā dōst dāram.

entries.exampleEn: Certainly this is the best way.
He quickly went to the hospital.
Based on the reports, it is raining.

entries.exampleDari: با وجود مریضی، به مکتب رفت.
entries.exampleTranslit: bā wujūd-i marēzī, ba maktab raft.
entries.exampleEn: Despite the illness, he went to school.

entries.exampleDari: به علاوه این، پول هم داد.
entries.exampleTranslit: ba ilāwa-i īn, pūl ham dād.
entries.exampleEn: In addition to this, he also gave money.

entries.exampleDari: به غیر از تو کسی را ندارم.
entries.exampleTranslit: ba ghayr az tu kasē rā nadāram.
entries.exampleEn: I have no one other than you.

entries.exampleDari: پیام به وسیله کبوتر فرستاده شد.
entries.exampleTranslit: payām ba wasīla-i kabūtar firistāda shud.
entries.exampleEn: The message was sent by means of a pigeon.

entries.exampleDari: راجع به این موضوع صحبت کردیم.
entries.exampleTranslit: rāji' ba īn mawzū' suhbat kardēm.

entries.exampleDari: فاصله بین دو شهر کم است.
entries.exampleTranslit: fāsila bayn-i du shahr kam ast.
entries.exampleEn: The distance between the two cities is short.
He lives outside of the country.
There is a wall around the city.
There are trees in the surroundings of the house.
I will return within a week.
As a result, the exam was canceled.

entries.exampleDari: با این حال، او تسلیم نشد.
entries.exampleTranslit: bā īn hāl, ō taslīm nashud.
entries.exampleEn: However, he did not give up.

entries.exampleDari: او می‌خندید در حالی که من گریه می‌کردم.
entries.exampleTranslit: ō mēkhandīd dar hālē ki man girya mēkardam.
entries.exampleEn: He was laughing while I was crying.
Although I was tired, I worked.
Even though he had no money, he was happy.

entries.exampleDari: می‌آیم به شرطی که زود برگردیم.
entries.exampleTranslit: mēāyam ba shartē ki zūd bargardēm.
entries.exampleEn: I will come provided that we return early.
I will not go unless he comes.
In case it rains, we will not go.

entries.exampleDari: خواه بیایی خواه نیایی، من می‌روم.
entries.exampleTranslit: khāh biyāyī khāh nayāyī, man mērawam.
entries.exampleEn: Whether you come or not, I will go.

entries.exampleDari: نه تنها زرنگ است بلکه مهربان هم است.
entries.exampleTranslit: na tanhā zirang ast balki mihrabān ham ast.
entries.exampleEn: Not only is he smart but also kind.

entries.exampleDari: هم علی و هم احمد آمدند.
entries.exampleTranslit: ham alī wa ham ahmad āmadand.

entries.exampleDari: از این رو، کار را تمام کردیم.
entries.exampleTranslit: az īn rō, kār rā tamām kardēm.

entries.exampleEn: For this reason I came late.

entries.exampleDari: با این وجود، او تلاش کرد.
entries.exampleTranslit: bā īn wujūd, ō talāsh kard.

entries.exampleDari: از آنجایی که هوا سرد است، لباس گرم بپوش.
entries.exampleTranslit: az ānjāyē ki hawā sard ast, libās-i garm bipōsh.
entries.exampleEn: Since the weather is cold, wear warm clothes.
Just as I said, he didn't come.

entries.exampleDari: طوری که به نظر می‌رسد، او بیمار است.
entries.exampleTranslit: tawrē ki ba nazar mērasad, ō bēmār ast.
entries.exampleEn: The way it seems, he is sick.

entries.exampleDari: آهسته صحبت کن به طوری که بیدار نشود.
entries.exampleTranslit: āhista suhbat kun ba tawrē ki bēdār nashawad.
entries.exampleEn: Speak softly so that he doesn't wake up.
He didn't come because he was sick.
Because I didn't have time, I didn't go.
It is cold, bring a blanket.
The water is in the refrigerator.
The food is on the stove.
Give me a glass of water.
I washed my hands with soap.
